sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 4's DPS/mechanics check — a platform with edges you can fall off, tears that need closing, and a support NPC (Saul) whose buffs matter.

sections.heading: Tears
bullets: Demonic tears shoot projections at player locations — step into a tear's void to close it.
Closing a tear gives you a short debuff that stops you closing another one right away — spread tear duty across the squad, don't rely on one person.

sections.heading: Annihilate & Mind Crush
bullets: Annihilate smashes the ground and knocks everyone back — dangerous near the platform edge, since it can knock you off to an instant death.
Mind Crush applies Weak Minded, dealing 70% of max HP over 10 seconds unless you're standing in Saul's protective ward — get to the ward if you're hit.

sections.heading: Saul
bullets: Saul bolsters the squad's morale (movement speed) and provides the ward — keep him alive and pay attention to his callouts.
